summary: Zeo ScientifiX filed a Form 8-K announcing it will host a live virtual educational webinar for healthcare professionals on July 22, 2026. The webinar, titled 'One Year Later, Three States Stronger: The Southeast Regen Revolution,' will discuss the first year of Florida's stem cell law and similar laws in Tennessee and Georgia. No deal terms, advisory roles, or material corporate events are involved. This is a routine event announcement, not a special situation.
